summary: Tested personalized job match analysis feature. Backend API correctly returns grounded_strengths with requirement, evidence, and match_reason fields. Fixed bug where grounded_strengths and matched_skills fields were not being passed through to job responses (added to 4 locations in server.py). All 9 backend tests pass. Frontend Analyze Match dialog displays personalized insights including Decision Summary, Your Strengths, and Improvement Opportunities.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - Analyze Match dialog and job search working correctly

context_for_next_testing_agent: Personalized job match analysis feature is fully working. Backend evaluate_job_match() function returns grounded_strengths array with {requirement, evidence, match_reason} fields. Evidence is extracted from user's actual resume text. Frontend /jobs page displays match scores and the Analyze Match dialog shows detailed GPT-powered analysis with Decision Summary, Your Strengths, Improvement Opportunities, and Keywords sections.
